words.example_en: The manager gave a brief introduction before the meeting.
words.example_zh: 会议开始前，经理做了简短的介绍。

使适应，使符合一致；调和(分歧等)；帮助，给……提供方便；向……提供住处(或膳宿)；容纳，接纳

words.example_en: The hotel can accommodate up to five hundred guests.
words.example_zh: 这家酒店最多可容纳五百位客人。

words.example_en: I like to browse the internet for news in the morning.
words.example_zh: 我喜欢早上上网浏览新闻。

words.example_en: The university provides accommodation for all first-year students.
words.example_zh: 大学为所有一年级学生提供住宿。

words.example_en: His constant complaints aggravated the situation.
words.example_zh: 他不断的抱怨使情况恶化了。

陪伴，伴随；为……伴奏(或伴唱)

words.example_en: She accompanied her mother to the doctor's office.
words.example_zh: 她陪母亲去了医生的办公室。

words.example_en: The aggregate of all the donations reached ten thousand dollars.
words.example_zh: 所有捐款的总数达到了一万美元。

meanings: 达到(目的)，完成(任务)，实现(计划、诺言等)

达到(目的)，完成(任务)，实现(计划、诺言等)；做到，做成；走完(距离等)，度完(时间)

words.example_en: He accomplished all his goals before the deadline.
words.example_zh: 他在截止日期前完成了所有目标。

meanings: 积极进取的，活跃有为的

好斗的，侵略的；积极进取的，活跃有为的

words.example_en: The company adopted an aggressive marketing strategy to expand sales.
words.example_zh: 公司采取了积极进取的营销策略来扩大销售。

words.example_en: The bad weather accounted for the delay of the flight.
words.example_zh: 恶劣的天气是航班延误的原因。

搅动（液体等）；使激动，使狂躁

words.example_en: The strong wind agitated the surface of the lake.
words.example_zh: 强风搅动了湖面。

words.example_en: The accountant is preparing the annual financial report.
words.example_zh: 会计正在准备年度财务报告。

易相处的；同意的；惬意的，令人愉快的

words.example_en: She is an agreeable person and easy to get along with.
words.example_zh: 她是个随和的人，容易相处。

words.example_en: The report showed a clear bias against minority groups.
words.example_zh: 这份报告显示出对少数群体的明显偏见。

援助，救济；助手；辅助物，辅助设备

words.example_en: The Red Cross provided aid to the flood victims.
words.example_zh: 红十字会向洪水灾民提供了援助。

words.example_en: She made a bid for the company's top position.
words.example_zh: 她争取公司最高职位。

meanings: 目的在于，旨在，以……为目的

目的在于，旨在，以……为目的；瞄准，针对

words.example_en: The new program aims to reduce pollution in the city.
words.example_zh: 新项目旨在减少城市污染。

words.example_en: Please pay the bill before you leave the restaurant.
words.example_zh: 离开餐厅前请结账。

惊恐，忧虑；警报，警钟，报警器
使惊恐，使忧虑；向……报警，使警觉

words.example_en: The fire alarm went off in the middle of the night.
words.example_zh: 火警在半夜响了起来。

words.example_en: The birth of the internet changed the world forever.
words.example_zh: 互联网的诞生永远改变了世界。

陌生的；外国的；不相容的，格格不入的；性质不同的，异己的
外国人，外侨；外星人，外星生物

words.example_en: The idea of living abroad seemed alien to him at first.
words.example_zh: 起初，在国外生活的想法对他来说很陌生。

words.example_en: The hotel charges fifty dollars for a single room.
words.example_zh: 这家酒店单人间收费五十美元。

排斥，疏远；使不友好；离间；使格格不入；使疏远

words.example_en: His rude behavior alienated many of his former friends.
words.example_zh: 他粗鲁的行为疏远了许多以前的朋友。

words.example_en: The old town has a charm that attracts many tourists.
words.example_zh: 这座古镇有一种魅力，吸引了许多游客。

words.example_en: The school allocated more funds to the science department.
words.example_zh: 学校给科学系分配了更多资金。

words.example_en: The dog chased the cat across the yard.
words.example_zh: 狗在院子里追赶猫。

words.example_en: Please allow me to introduce myself.
words.example_zh: 请允许我自我介绍一下。

words.example_en: The workers demanded higher wages from the company.
words.example_zh: 工人们要求公司提高工资。

words.example_en: The weather can alter our plans for the picnic.
words.example_zh: 天气可能会改变我们野餐的计划。

words.example_en: Democracy allows citizens to choose their leaders.
words.example_zh: 民主允许公民选择他们的领导人。

words.example_en: We alternate between walking and running during our morning exercise.
words.example_zh: 我们早晨锻炼时交替进行走路和跑步。

words.example_en: The country held its first democratic election last year.
words.example_zh: 这个国家去年举行了首次民主选举。

meanings: 可供选的事物，替换物，抉择对象

两者挑一的；可供选择的
可供选的事物，替换物，抉择对象

words.example_en: We had to find an alternative route because the main road was closed.
words.example_zh: 由于主干道封闭，我们不得不寻找另一条路线。

meanings: 人口统计学的，人口统计的

人口统计学的，人口统计的

words.example_en: The demographic data shows a growing elderly population.
words.example_zh: 人口统计数据显示老年人口在增长。

meanings: 可比较的，比得上的，类似的

可比较的，比得上的，类似的

words.example_en: The quality of this product is comparable to that of a much more expensive brand.
words.example_zh: 这个产品的质量可以与更昂贵的品牌相媲美。

meanings: 示范，宣传(产品的)用法(或优点)

示范，宣传(产品的)用法(或优点)

words.example_en: The teacher demonstrated how to solve the math problem.
words.example_zh: 老师演示了如何解这道数学题。

meanings: 相比之下的，相比而言的，相对的

比较的，相比的；相比之下的，相比而言的，相对的

words.example_en: After a comparative study, we chose the cheaper plan.
words.example_zh: 经过比较研究后，我们选择了更便宜的计划。

words.example_en: The symbol '*' denotes multiplication in this formula.
words.example_zh: 在这个公式中，符号 '*' 表示乘法。

words.example_en: Don't compare your life with others; everyone's journey is unique.
words.example_zh: 不要把你的生活与他人比较；每个人的旅程都是独特的。

words.example_en: His denial of the accusation surprised everyone.
words.example_zh: 他对指控的否认让所有人惊讶。

比较，对比，比喻，比拟；比较起来

words.example_en: In comparison with last year, our sales have increased significantly.
words.example_zh: 与去年相比，我们的销售额显著增长了。

words.example_en: She denied stealing the money from the office.
words.example_zh: 她否认从办公室偷了钱。

words.example_en: The new evidence compelled the judge to reconsider the case.
words.example_zh: 新证据迫使法官重新考虑此案。

words.example_en: He works in the sales department of a large company.
words.example_zh: 他在一家大公司的销售部门工作。

words.example_en: The company will compensate you for any damage caused by the accident.
words.example_zh: 公司将赔偿事故造成的任何损失。

words.example_en: Your success depends on how hard you work.
words.example_zh: 你的成功取决于你努力的程度。

words.example_en: Several teams will compete for the championship this weekend.
words.example_zh: 几支队伍将在本周末争夺冠军。

words.example_en: The child is still dependent on his parents for food.
words.example_zh: 这个孩子仍然依赖父母提供食物。

words.example_en: The competition among the candidates was very fierce.
words.example_zh: 候选人之间的竞争非常激烈。

words.example_en: You need to deposit a hundred dollars to rent the car.
words.example_zh: 租这辆车你需要存一百美元押金。

words.example_en: She is very competitive and always wants to win the game.
words.example_zh: 她非常好胜，总是想赢得比赛。

words.example_en: Bad weather can depress people's mood easily.
words.example_zh: 坏天气容易使人情绪低落。

有能力的，能胜任的；不错的（但并不出色）

words.example_en: He is a competent lawyer who handles cases efficiently.
words.example_zh: 他是一位能干的律师，处理案件效率很高。

words.example_en: The sun emerged from behind the clouds at noon.
words.example_zh: 中午太阳从云层后面出现了。

words.example_en: The teacher asked us to compile a list of useful expressions.
words.example_zh: 老师让我们汇编一份有用的表达列表。

meanings: 紧急情况，突然事件，非常时刻

紧急情况，突然事件，非常时刻

words.example_en: In case of emergency, call the police immediately.
words.example_zh: 遇到紧急情况，立即报警。

words.example_en: Customers often complain about the slow service at this restaurant.
words.example_zh: 顾客经常抱怨这家餐厅服务慢。

words.example_en: She is an eminent scientist in the field of physics.
words.example_zh: 她是物理学领域的杰出科学家。

words.example_en: She filed a complaint about the noisy neighbors.
words.example_zh: 她投诉了吵闹的邻居。

words.example_en: He could not control his emotions when he heard the news.
words.example_zh: 听到这个消息时，他无法控制自己的情绪。

words.example_en: The wine perfectly complements the flavors of the dish.
words.example_zh: 这种酒完美地补充了这道菜的风味。

words.example_en: She has a fear of flying, so she travels by train.
words.example_zh: 她害怕坐飞机，所以乘火车旅行。

完全的，完整的，彻底的；完成的，完结的

words.example_en: Please complete the form before you submit it online.
words.example_zh: 请在网上提交之前完成这个表格。

words.example_en: The fearful child hid behind his mother during the storm.
words.example_zh: 暴风雨中，害怕的孩子躲在母亲身后。

复杂的，费解的；合成的，综合的

words.example_en: The instructions were too complex for the average user to follow.
words.example_zh: 这些说明太复杂，普通用户难以遵循。

words.example_en: The main feature of this phone is its long battery life.
words.example_zh: 这款手机的主要特点是电池续航时间长。

words.example_en: Don't complicate the problem by adding unnecessary details.
words.example_zh: 不要通过添加不必要的细节使问题复杂化。

words.example_en: The federal government passed a new law on education.
words.example_zh: 联邦政府通过了一项新的教育法律。

words.example_en: The new software has a complicated setup process.
words.example_zh: 这个新软件的安装过程很复杂。

words.example_en: The country is a federation of several states.
words.example_zh: 这个国家是由几个州组成的联邦。

words.example_en: All visitors must comply with the safety regulations.
words.example_zh: 所有访客必须遵守安全规定。

words.example_en: She feeds the cat twice a day with fresh fish.
words.example_zh: 她每天用新鲜鱼喂猫两次。

words.example_en: She received many compliments on her excellent presentation.
words.example_zh: 她的出色演讲收到了许多称赞。

words.example_en: We need more feedback from our customers to improve the product.
words.example_zh: 我们需要更多来自客户的反馈来改进产品。

words.example_en: The two brothers differ greatly in their opinions about politics.
words.example_zh: 这两个兄弟在政治观点上大不相同。

words.example_en: She had a strange feeling that someone was watching her.
words.example_zh: 她有一种奇怪的感觉，觉得有人在看她。

meanings: 差别，不同（之处），变化（之处）

差别，不同（之处），变化（之处）；差，差额；意见分歧，不和

words.example_en: There is a big difference between knowing and doing.
words.example_zh: 知道和做之间有很大的差别。

words.example_en: The fertile soil in this valley produces excellent crops.
words.example_zh: 这个山谷肥沃的土壤出产优质庄稼。

扩散（气体、液体等）；传播，散布
弥漫的，四散的；（文章等）冗长的，漫无边际的

words.example_en: The scent of flowers slowly diffused throughout the room.
words.example_zh: 花香慢慢弥漫了整个房间。

words.example_en: His main goal is to become a successful engineer.
words.example_zh: 他的主要目标是成为一名成功的工程师。

words.example_en: The course places great emphasis on practical skills.
words.example_zh: 这门课程非常强调实用技能。

words.example_en: The store sells a wide range of electronic goods.
words.example_zh: 这家商店出售各种各样的电子产品。

words.example_en: The teacher emphasized the importance of regular review.
words.example_zh: 老师强调了定期复习的重要性。

words.example_en: Laws govern the behavior of citizens in a society.
words.example_zh: 法律管理着社会中公民的行为。

words.example_en: The factory employs over two hundred workers.
words.example_zh: 这家工厂雇用了两百多名工人。

words.example_en: The government is planning to build more hospitals.
words.example_zh: 政府正计划建造更多医院。

words.example_en: Every employee is required to attend the safety training.
words.example_zh: 每位员工都必须参加安全培训。

words.example_en: The governor visited the school to discuss education policy.
words.example_zh: 州长访问了这所学校，讨论教育政策。

words.example_en: The employer promised to provide better working conditions.
words.example_zh: 雇主承诺提供更好的工作条件。

words.example_en: There has been a gradual increase in the number of students.
words.example_zh: 学生人数一直在逐渐增加。

words.example_en: She found employment at a local hospital after graduation.
words.example_zh: 毕业后她在当地一家医院找到了工作。

有学位的，毕业的；研究生的

words.example_en: After she graduates, she wants to work abroad.
words.example_zh: 毕业后，她想去国外工作。

words.example_en: The new software will enable us to work more efficiently.
words.example_zh: 这个新软件将使我们能够更高效地工作。

meanings: 重大的，主要的，最重要的

盛大的，豪华的；重大的，主要的，最重要的

words.example_en: They held a grand celebration for their anniversary.
words.example_zh: 他们为周年纪念举行了盛大的庆祝活动。

冲突，交战；（意外地）遇见，遭遇

words.example_en: We encountered many difficulties during the project.
words.example_zh: 在项目过程中我们遇到了许多困难。

words.example_en: The university granted him a scholarship for his research.
words.example_zh: 大学为他的研究授予了奖学金。

鼓励，支持；发展，激励，促进

words.example_en: My teacher encouraged me to apply for the scholarship.
words.example_zh: 我的老师鼓励我申请奖学金。

堆积；大量地(或慷慨地)给予；装满

words.example_en: There was a heap of dirty clothes on the floor.
words.example_zh: 地上有一堆脏衣服。

words.example_en: The meeting ended at five o'clock in the afternoon.
words.example_zh: 会议在下午五点结束。

治愈，愈合；调停，止息，消除，克服

words.example_en: Time can heal many emotional wounds.
words.example_zh: 时间能治愈许多情感创伤。

words.example_en: She endeavoured to finish the project before the deadline.
words.example_zh: 她努力在截止日期前完成这个项目。

words.example_en: Regular exercise is important for your health.
words.example_zh: 定期锻炼对你的健康很重要。

meanings: （在驾驶执照上）记录违章事项

（公开）赞同，支持，认可；（在支票背面）签名；（在驾驶执照上）记录违章事项；（广告中）宣传，代言（某一产品）

words.example_en: The famous athlete endorsed the new sports drink.
words.example_zh: 这位著名运动员代言了这款新运动饮料。

健康的，健壮的；有益健康的，卫生的

words.example_en: Eating vegetables and fruits keeps you healthy.
words.example_zh: 吃蔬菜和水果使你保持健康。

表明，显示；示意，暗示；指出，指示

words.example_en: The results indicate that the plan is working well.
words.example_zh: 结果表明该计划运行良好。

words.example_en: Don't hesitate to ask me if you have any questions.
words.example_zh: 如果你有任何问题，不要犹豫，尽管问我。

words.example_en: There is no indication that he will change his mind.
words.example_zh: 没有迹象表明他会改变主意。

meanings: 对(某事物)予以特别的注意
将(部分头发)染成浅色使之有光泽
最有意思或精彩的部分

使显著，使突出；强调；对(某事物)予以特别的注意；将(部分头发)染成浅色使之有光泽
最有意思或精彩的部分

words.example_en: The report highlights the need for better safety measures.
words.example_zh: 报告强调了改进安全措施的必要性。

words.example_en: His smile was indicative of his approval.
words.example_zh: 他的微笑表明他同意了。

words.example_en: She is highly respected by her colleagues.
words.example_zh: 她深受同事们的尊敬。

伤害，虐待，暴行，侮辱；愤怒；凌辱

words.example_en: The decision caused public outrage across the country.
words.example_zh: 这一决定在全国引起了公愤。

立即的，即时的；直接的，最接近的

words.example_en: The medicine gave immediate relief from the pain.
words.example_zh: 这种药立即缓解了疼痛。

words.example_en: We should have discussed the budget at the outset.
words.example_zh: 我们本应在开始时讨论预算。

words.example_en: The project requires an immense amount of time and effort.
words.example_zh: 这个项目需要大量的时间和精力。

在外面的，向外的；不相关，可能性极小的
在……外面，向……外面；离开，不在；不属于……范围之内

words.example_en: Please wait outside the office until I call you.
words.example_zh: 请在外面办公室等候，直到我叫你。

使浸没；使沉浸在，使专心于

words.example_en: He immersed himself in his studies before the exam.
words.example_zh: 考试前他埋头学习。

words.example_en: She showed no outward signs of nervousness.
words.example_zh: 她没有表现出任何紧张的外在迹象。

words.example_en: Many immigrants come to this country seeking a better life.
words.example_zh: 许多移民来到这个国家寻求更好的生活。

words.example_en: This is a special day for our family.
words.example_zh: 这是我们家庭特别的一天。

meanings: (尤指不愉快的事)即将发生的，临近的

(尤指不愉快的事)即将发生的，临近的

words.example_en: A storm is imminent, so we should go inside now.
words.example_zh: 暴风雨即将来临，我们现在应该进屋。

words.example_en: He is a specialist in heart surgery.
words.example_zh: 他是心脏外科专家。

免除的，豁免的；可防止的，不受影响的；免疫的，有免疫力的

words.example_en: After vaccination, you become immune to the disease.
words.example_zh: 接种疫苗后，你对这种疾病就具有免疫力了。

专攻，专门研究；专注于；以……闻名

words.example_en: He decided to specialize in environmental law after graduation.
words.example_zh: 他决定毕业后专攻环境法。

words.example_en: It is likely to rain this afternoon, so bring an umbrella.
words.example_zh: 今天下午很可能下雨，所以带把伞。

words.example_en: Seafood is the specialty of this coastal restaurant.
words.example_zh: 海鲜是这家沿海餐馆的特色。

words.example_en: There is a high likelihood that he will win the election.
words.example_zh: 他赢得选举的可能性很大。

words.example_en: Many species of birds migrate south in winter.
words.example_zh: 许多鸟类在冬天向南迁徙。

同样地，照样地；又，也，而且

words.example_en: I enjoyed the movie, and my brother felt likewise.
words.example_zh: 我喜欢这部电影，我哥哥也有同感。

明确的，具体的；特定的，特有的

words.example_en: Please give me a specific example of your point.
words.example_zh: 请给我一个你观点的具体例子。

meanings: (自己的)通常的行为方式，本来面目，惯常心态

个性，自我，本身，自己；(自己的)通常的行为方式，本来面目，惯常心态；个人利益；私心

words.example_en: She is always thinking of others and never of self.
words.example_zh: 她总是想着别人，从不考虑自己。

详述，明确；规格，说明书，规范

words.example_en: The engineer checked the specifications of the machine.
